text:
alex: Pre-cut green sweep — can folks run a quick CI pass on release/* branches and keep an eye on any dep-update PRs? Targeting a v2.4.1 bump today, would like to cut within the next couple hours if we get green. pinging @maya @sam @leo @olivia

maya: starting a greensweep on staging + canary now. will post failures as they show.

ci-bot: Started job: build/greensweep-staging (jenkins.example/greensweep/7823) - status: running

sam: saw a failure in integration-test: token-cache on linux-x86, looks like a flaky timeout. job: https://ci/greensweep/7823
```
E   AssertionError: cache miss rate > 2%
.../tests/test_token_cache.py:42
```

maya: assigning to @sam to triage; I'll rerun the job with `SKIP_SLOW=true` to isolate (should rule out timing-sensitive flakes).

leo: also noticed dep-update PR #421 bumped grpc -> 1.45.0 recently; seeing some connection to deadline exceeded stack traces in worker-side calls. recommend pinning to 1.44.x on release/* until we verify.

olivia: for changelog: we need a short blurb about the grpc revert/pin and the token-cache perf fix. @alex can you draft the lines and I'll drop them into the release notes?

sam: quick repro steps if anyone wants to run locally:
```
make test-integration && pytest tests/test_token_cache.py::test_cache_eviction -q
```
I can bisect the dep if we decide to, but pinning sounds faster.

qa: if this is consistently reproducing in the greensweep, let's add it to flaky-rotation and start a short investigation window. tagging `flake:token-cache` in our tracker.

ci-bot: Rerun complete: build/greensweep-staging #7823 -> FAILED (1 failing). flake label added to tests/test_token_cache.py::test_cache_eviction.

maya: ok i re-ran with grpc pinned to 1.44.2 on a branch and it's green locally and on canary. opening hotfix PR to pin on release/*, cc @sam for signoff.

alex: Plan: 1) maya opens pin PR and we merge after Sam signoff; 2) Olivia will add changelog blurb; 3) Leo please hold other dep bumps to a later cut; 4) i'll coordinate a final greensweep + tag v2.4.1. ETA ~2 hours. Thanks :raised_hands:
